campaign.post_title: One Smile, One World — 笑一笑，世界更美妙 (2026)
campaign.post_content:
One Smile, One World (PROJECT 002) is Malaysia's first national movement inviting students to recall the smile of someone they are grateful for — a parent, teacher, or anyone who made a difference — draw it, and share one heartfelt sentence.

10,000 Smiles. One Ecosystem. · 笑一笑，世界更美妙

In school (~1 hour)

  1. Warm-up — mentor emotional story (5 min)
  2. Guided awareness — recall a grateful person's smile (60 sec)
  3. Drawing — ~35 min
  4. Heartfelt message on artwork (5 min)
  5. Mentor sharing — emotional management & life wisdom (10 min)
  6. Wrap-up — collect art, submission code for parent, gift pack, photo

After school (parents)

Register on Creative Wings, enter the submission code from school, confirm the student's name, and complete registration. School sponsor coupon = free; public registration = RM 15.

Year-end showcase

10,000 Smiles Showcase — national gallery exhibition targeted November 2026. Top smiles curated for the gallery wall.

Hashtag: #OneSmileOneWorld · Organiser: Creative Wings · creativewings.asia

faq.question: Who can join One Smile, One World?
faq.answer: Primary and secondary students via participating schools nationwide. Adults and university students may register under the Public category. Parents complete online registration after the in-school session using the submission code from school.

faq.question: What is a submission code?
faq.answer: A 13-digit code from your school PIC, e.g. 0020600100001 (campaign 002 + month + school + sequence). Parents enter this code in My Account → Link submission code.

faq.question: Is there a fee?
faq.answer: Students from sponsor schools register free using the school WooCommerce coupon. Public or non-sponsored participants pay RM 15 on checkout.

faq.question: What do I submit?
faq.answer: Your smiling-face artwork is uploaded at school by the PIC. Online you confirm the name, add your heartfelt message, and receive a digital participation certificate after completion.

faq.question: When is the national gallery?
faq.answer: The 10,000 Smiles Showcase is targeted for November 2026. Top artworks may be featured on the national gallery wall.

faq.question: Can I change my artwork after parent registration?
faq.answer: Before a parent claims your code, the school PIC can amend the submission using the same code at the staff upload link. After claim, contact Creative Wings admin for changes.
